d:
Raj, a detective, goes on a Europe trip for his friend's case. During the trip, he falls in love with Anjali, who is impersonating her best friend. Their journey together ensues romance and comic confusion.
Had Kar Di Aapne is a 2000 Hindi language comedy love story film . This film stars Govinda and Rani Mukherjee in lead roles, along with Johny Lever, Paresh Rawal, and Satish Kaushik in supporting roles. Govinda played six characters in this film.
Music of the film was composed by Anand Raj Anand.
Movie - Hadh Kar Di Aapne (2000)
Director - Manoj Agrawal
